title: security: rbac v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 enforcement around KMS key region residency and improve audit logging for cross-region keys. This PR hardens enforcement paths used by Private deployments and Dedicated customers so that KMS-backed keys cannot be used outside configured region sets unless explicitly allowed. Changes also add structured audit entries for KMS operations to make post-incident analysis and compliance reporting reliable.

Summary of changes: - Add KMSRegionPinning policy checks in auth middleware and policy engine - Fail-fast for mismatched key residency when 'enforce_kms_residency' is enabled for an org - Add opt-in allowlist for admin service accounts that may perform cross-region ops (requires audit reason) - Emit structured audit log entries for KMS operations (key_id, requesting_principal, org_id, region, reason, policy_version) - Backfill small migration to populate existing audit metadata where available - Add unit + integration tests for middleware + audit entries - Update RBAC v2 docs and config schema with new flags and examples

Checklist:
- [x] Design review (ENG-4321) completed
- [x] Linear ticket linked (ENG-4321, SEC-210)
- [x] Unit tests added for policy evaluation paths
- [x] Integration tests for Private installer smoke with KMS emulation
- [x] End-to-end audit log schema validation added
- [x] Docs updated (rbac-v2.md, kms.md)

Testing and validation:
- Local unit test run: 1187 tests, 1187 passed
- CI (build + test + lint) initially failed on linting for a helper; fixed in follow-up commit and all checks passed on rerun
- Integration: ran Private installer smoke against KMS-mock across eu-west-1 / us-east-1 and verified enforcement, observed expected structured audit entries in the logging pipeline (GELF -> S3 archive)

Rollout plan:
- Deploy to staging with feature flag 'enforce_kms_residency=false' to validate logs/metrics for 48h
- Toggle enforcement for internal orgs only for 7 days, monitor audit volume and error rates
- Gradual rollout to customers after notice (configurable per-org via console API)
- Emergency rollback: set org flag 'enforce_kms_residency=false' or remove allowlist entry for service account

Notes:
- This is intentionally conservative; enforcement only triggers when org-level flag is enabled. We ship stronger audit logging first so SRE and security teams can baseline behavior before wide enforcement.
- Related: ENG-4321, SEC-210, SUP-1123

Lina Chen: Nit: split the kafka/audit payload assembly into its own helper for testability. Also add schema version to the log entry.
Asha Patel: Split helper as requested and bumped audit schema to v2 in audit_writer.go. Added schema validation test.
